---
title: "Schedule"
subtitle: "The semester at a glance"
---

The course moves through four phases. The classroom rhythm shifts as it goes: early weeks are mostly **convergent** (questions with right answers), and once we learn more computing ideas, we start doing more things that are **divergent** (open-ended work, critiques, "why did your AI's answer come out different from ours?").

Read the lesson *before* the class it's listed under. 

::: {.callout-note}
## Checkpoints
The ✓ marks: those Tuesdays open with a ~20-minute individual, on-paper, no-AI checkpoint covering recent convergent standards and re-offering earlier ones. Details on the [grading page](grading.qmd).
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Homework 
[Homework sets](../homework/index.qmd) are assigned in weeks 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, and 11.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Base Camp/Side Quest Sessions
... happen on Mondays: [Base Camp](basecamp.qmd)/[Side Quests](sidequests.qmd). (Optional.)
:::

| **Phase 0 — Thinking** | | | |

| 5 | [Loops, arrays & sweeps](../lessons/05-loops-sweeps.qmd) — computational superpowers. | [Sweep lab](../activities/w05-sweep-lab.qmd) — predict all outcomes of a process. | P2, S4 |
| 6 | ✓ **Checkpoint 2**, then [Data in, data out](../lessons/06-data-io-plots.qmd) — files, CSV, and plotting. | [Plot clinic](../activities/w06-plot-clinic.qmd) — make one honest plot, catch one misleading one. | F2, A2 |
| **Phase 2 — Tools** | | | |

| 9 | [Simulate I](../lessons/09-simulate-1.qmd) — time-stepping a model into the future. | [Build-a-model lab](../activities/w09-model-lab.qmd) — every table marches a different system. | S1, S3 |
| 10 | ✓ **Checkpoint 4**, then [Simulate II](../lessons/10-simulate-2.qmd) — assumptions, trust, and what-ifs. | [Model critique](../activities/w10-model-critique.qmd) — every table's model is wrong differently. | S2, S3, S4 |
| **Phase 3 — Integration** | | | |
| 11 | [Your second language](../lessons/11-matlab.qmd) — MATLAB, translation, and choosing tools. | [**Project launch**](../activities/w11-launch.qmd) — menu, teams, spec zero. | P4, A4 |

| 13 | Project studio — desk crits at tables. | [Pin-up #2](../activities/w13-pinup-2.qmd) — working artifacts, same-project pairing. | A2, A3, P5 |
| 14 | [Defense prep](../lessons/14-defense.qmd) — what it means to know your own project. | [Mock defenses](../activities/w14-mock-defense.qmd) at tables. | P5 |
